title: Inbox: WhatsApp, email, SMS and chat

scenes.title: One inbox for every channel
scenes.subtitle: WhatsApp, email, SMS and website chat
scenes.narration: Customers write on WhatsApp, by email, by text and on your website. All of it lands in one shared inbox.
A WhatsApp message comes in from a customer. It appears in the inbox straight away, matched to the contact, with no refresh.
Open the conversation to see the whole history with this customer, across every channel, in one thread.
Reply from the same screen. Pick a channel and a template, check the preview, and send. Every message is logged against the contact.
Emails to your enquiry address arrive in the same inbox, and replies go out with your own email signature.
To reach many customers at once, choose an audience by tag, pick a template, and preview it before anything goes out.
Message templates keep your wording consistent, with the customer's name and trip details filled in for you.
Connect your channels once. Add your enquiry email address and WhatsApp number, connect your own Meta WhatsApp account, and give your website form its key.
On Enterprise, a chat widget on your website answers visitors and hands the conversation to your team. You can step in and reply yourself at any time.

scenes.headline: Every conversation in one place.
